metadata.description: Creator Publish: instruction-driven publishing-side skills. publish-core (first-run tour, saved per-project defaults, coordinator), compose (visual-composer: deterministic local rendering, renderer included), design (briefs and specs for quote cards, infographics, thumbnails, YouTube channel assets, Apple Podcasts show art, Spotify show assets, X profile and post assets, pins, brand templates), image-gen (image prompt craft and routing), canva (Canva connector execution), post (per-post recommendations, spec checks and owner-approved posting).

plugins.name: publish-core
plugins.description: Entry point: first-run tour and setup, saved per-project defaults, and coordination of the other skills. Saves resumable package status; posts only with explicit per-post approval.

plugins.name: compose
plugins.description: visual-composer: deterministic local composition and rendering of supplied assets from a JSON spec. The renderer ships inside the plugin (Node CLI and MCP server). No generation.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Design briefs for static social graphics: quote cards and text graphics, infographics and data viz, YouTube thumbnails, YouTube channel assets (banner, profile picture, watermark, end-screen guide, channel copy), Apple Podcasts show assets (show cover, episode art, small-size previews, show copy), Spotify show assets (feed cover reuse, video-podcast thumbnail, small-size previews, show copy), X profile and post assets (header, profile photo, post and pinned images, alt text, X copy), Pinterest pins, and a brand template system. Writes the brief and a visual-composer composition spec; rendering is compose (or Canva). Mostly adapted from social-media-skills (MIT).

plugins.name: image-gen
plugins.description: Image prompt craft and routing: image-prompt router plus Nano Banana, FLUX, Ideogram and AI image editing. Writes provider-ready prompts and edit plans for whichever provider you connect (Gemini API, OpenAI, Black Forest Labs, Ideogram, Higgsfield or another host); no default provider. Adapted from social-media-skills (MIT).

plugins.name: canva
plugins.description: Canva execution via the Canva connector: brand kits, templates, generate, resize, remove background, export. Cloud, editable alternative to compose's deterministic local renderer. Adapted from social-media-skills (MIT).

plugins.name: post
plugins.description: post: recommends platform/format/caption/hashtags per post, checks the file against platform specs, posts or schedules only after the owner's explicit OK per post, records it in the package status. Adapted from social-media-skills (MIT).
